transformation: Only image and preview.image local paths changed from /products/ to /verified-products/. Original image bytes and all source metadata are preserved.
priceScope: Every price is a historical reference, not a live offer. Stock, seller selection, exact option IDs and delivery remain unverified unless the original record explicitly provides evidence.
reviewScope: Partial reviewEvidence is translated/paraphrased third-party product-family evidence. It is not our seeded synthetic review corpus, a complete review set, or necessarily evidence for the exact pictured variant. Preserve each original scopeNote.
syntheticIsolation: No synthetic product has been assigned a real brand, image or review in this import.
